name: XGrammar
summary: Fast portable structured-generation engine for LLM grammars and constrained decoding (MLC AI).
description: Apache-2.0 structured-generation engine (mlc-ai/xgrammar; not archived). PyPI xgrammar 0.2.9 verified 2026-11-11 (0.2.8 remains a prior release; 0.2.9 was uploaded 2026-11-09 and is not yanked). Docs at https://xgrammar.mlc.ai/. Designed for flexible grammar-constrained generation across backends. Model and runtime costs are separate.

agent_access.notes: Install via pip install xgrammar; integrate with supported inference stacks.
